articles.headline: USC's JuJu Watkins is back and maybe better than ever, 588 days after injury
articles.description: In March 2025, then-player of the year JuJu Watkins tore her ACL. Now, 588 days later, her journey back to the court is complete.

images.name: The return of JuJu Watkins [1500x844]
images.caption: JuJu Watkins, the national player of the year in 2024-25, will play her first official game Monday when USC opens its season at UNLV, 588 days after she tore her ACL.

images.name: JuJu Watkins [1296x729] - Copy
images.caption: While dribbling downcourt on a fast break, JuJu Watkins suffered a torn ACL in a second-round NCAA tournament game on March 24, 2025.

images.name: JuJu Watkins and Jazzy Davidson [1296x729]
images.caption: "She really harps on me to give myself grace," sophomore Jazzy Davidson said of Juju Watkins. "She tells me to slow down. When I have the ball in my hands, she says to take a beat, take a deep breath."

images.name: JuJu Watkins preseason scrimmage [1296x729]
images.caption: In USC's 78-76 exhibition victory over Cal on Oct. 25, JuJu Watkins tallied 18 points,  three rebounds, three steals and two blocks in 23 minutes.
